title: Notched TEP prior: exploiting the solar-illumination-independent TEP continuum for out-of-year generalisation
interpretation: The notched TEP continuum BEATS the full-band TEP kernel on independent-year data (median +1.87%, CI95 [+1.64, +2.60]). The full-band kernel's failure on 2025 data (Step 92: -0.93%) was caused by the solar tidal lines — atmospheric modulations that do not generalise year-to-year.  Removing them yields a TEP continuum that generalises better.  This directly exploits the Step 125 finding as a predictive strength.
The notched TEP continuum is better than empirical covariance (median +0.34%, but CI95 includes zero).  The improvement is in the expected direction but not significant.
pre_registered_prediction: The full-band TEP kernel fails on 2025 data (Step 92: -0.93%) because the solar tidal lines are atmospheric modulations that do not generalise year-to-year.  The notched TEP continuum (lambda=1877 km, solar-illumination-independent per Step 125) should beat both the full-band TEP kernel and the empirical covariance on independent-year data.  This exploits the atmospheric modulation finding as a predictive strength: by removing the modulations, we isolate the stable TEP continuum that generalises across years.
